hypotheses.V0_native_branch_is_exact: Native logits match the checkpoint to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.V1_local_privilege_survives_value_matchi: At least five candidates retain aggregate local-operator ratio at least 1.5.
hypotheses.V2_local_privilege_is_bootstrap_robust: At least five candidates have local-effect ratio bootstrap lower bound above 1.0.
hypotheses.V3_local_privilege_is_not_top_tail_only: At least four candidates retain 95-percent-trimmed local ratio at least 1.5.
hypotheses.V4_downstream_privilege_survives_value_m: At least four candidates retain downstream KL ratio at least 1.5 with bootstrap lower bound above 1.0.
hypotheses.V5_broad_sitewise_role_is_supported: At least five candidates win against matched controls on at least 60 percent of sites.
